name: Apple 极简
description: 源自 rico-md 的「Apple 极简」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 12px 48px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: -0.01em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.2; margin: 36px 0 24px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.25; margin: 32px 0 20px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid {{accent}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.35; margin: 28px 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #6e6e73; line-height: 1.4; margin: 24px 0 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 13px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

strong.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; border: none; font-weight: 600; color: {{text}}; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 40px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #e8e8ed; max-width: 48px">
